name: pixelated-image
title: Pixelated Image
description: OGL image revealer that starts as coarse blocks and sharpens to full resolution over time.

usage.label: React

props.name: image
props.description: Image source URL used for the depixelation reveal.

props.name: initial-grid-size
props.description: Starting vertical grid size before each depixelation step doubles it.

props.name: step-duration
props.description: Seconds each depixelation step lasts before the grid doubles again.
